notes.title: v1.2.1 Official Achievement Hotfix
notes.content:
This update contains small achievements fixes

Finally have figured out the issue with Unity and Steamworks not identifying and setting achievements. This issue was caused by an out-of-date Unity version. Finally has been officially fixed and tested in this update!

notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.content:
Farstorm 1.1 Update

Files were recovered for Farstorm! The highly anticipated 1.1 update is here!

Fixed so many bugs, fixed so many visual glitches, updated animations, included new UI, fixed UI, and much more.

Please Enjoy, a more polished Farstorm.

More Story coming soon!

notes.title: Farstorm is BACK, with a surprise...
notes.content:
Farstorm is coming back, and is no longer depreciated!

Farstorm has been sitting dormant for awhile, and that’s because it’s been under some heavy changes. The games project files were lost, and due to this a reworking of the entire game would have to be done. 

Well it’s done!

And it’s coming soon, to all users who purchased Farstorm...

FARSTORM 2!

Purchase Farstorm to get Farstorm 2 and Farstorm together for much cheaper!

Farstorm 2 teasers will be here shortly, the game is so much improved!

Thank you loyal CG Creations fans!

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Farstorm's gonna get spooky!

Expect spooky pumpkins, new weapons, bug fixes, and more!

notes.title: 1.0.2 Release

notes.title: Regarding Torrents
notes.content:
Sadly, almost every video I could find, is a torrented copy of Farstorm. You can tell in two big ways.

Character Shaders are broken in Beak Village
Username and avatar on the titlescreen is not updated (AKA not with Steam)


I really would love to see a legit gameplay video or review. Thank you!

notes.title: Major Hotfix
notes.content: A bug was found in some gameplay videos, inside of Beak Villiage, that caused lighting to be broken and self-illumination was maxed out. This has been corrected, please update to the latest if you haven't already, thank you.
